local_sqlite.label: Local SQLite storage
local_sqlite.description: Ordinary application data stays in SQLite on the user's device.

manual_import.label: Manual statement import
manual_import.description: Import supported statement formats without a cloud data pipeline.

deterministic_classification.label: Deterministic classification
deterministic_classification.description: Rules, exact merchant memory, fuzzy matching, and confirmed patterns run locally.

dashboard_budgets.label: Dashboard and budgets
dashboard_budgets.description: Track spending, income, savings, and budget pressure from local calculations.

basic_reports.label: Local reports
basic_reports.description: Generate core reports from verified local calculations.

csv_export.label: CSV export
csv_export.description: Export transaction data without an account or paid license.

multi_bank.label: Multiple supported accounts
multi_bank.description: Add supported accounts beyond the free HDFC account.

ai_classification.label: Optional AI assistance
ai_classification.description: Use a validated local model or a bring-your-own provider key. No hosted credits are included.

advanced_reports.label: Advanced reports and explanations
advanced_reports.description: Unlock advanced locally calculated reports and optional explanatory assistance.

personal_classifier.label: Personal classifier
personal_classifier.description: After 200 confirmed corrections across at least five categories, enable a private personal classifier.

net_worth.label: Net-worth tracking
net_worth.description: Track local assets, liabilities, quote history, freshness, and calculation provenance. Live liquid-asset quotes use the user's own Twelve Data key.

behavior_insights.label: Financial behavior insights
behavior_insights.description: Explain deterministic savings, cash-flow, budget, subscription, buffer, and routine metrics with evidence, confidence, correction, hide, reset, and export controls.
